messages:
Jana (AE): putting this thread here so eng sees 1:30 PT - Sierra wants to run a POC on their in-house QLoRA 40B. theyre insisting on customer-managed keys and eu-only processing. they also asked if we can guarantee 99.9% uptime for the trial period.
Sam (Customer): also curious about per-token billing if we enable prefix caching. can you give a clear number?
Rohit (SE): quick answer: prefix cache reduces token spend but still counts generated tokens for billing. we can show estimated token burn based on sample traces.
Maya (ML Eng): on model fit: community QLoRA artifacts vary. well need to validate tokenizer, attention masks, and kv cache shape. commonly seen problems: mismatched tokenizer causing spammy tokens and fused kernels that our runtime can't load.
Maya (ML Eng): recommended conversion flow:
```
1. verify tokenizer model/vocab hash
2. convert to q4f16 using our quant-tool (run on a dev machine)
3. run kv-cache smoke: generate 10 responses with 8k context, compare logits
```
Carlos (Infra Eng): EU-only processing: hosted + CMEK is doable but you must accept that control plane metadata may touch US. Private (VPC) deployment keeps control plane local but needs longer lead time (~2 weeks).
Priya (Security): about KMS: we support BYOK (customer-provided keys) via our CMEK integration, but key rotation attestation and HSM proof requires Private deployment + signed attestation from infra. I'll need their key policy doc.
Rohit (SE): for the POC we can create a temporary catalog item: `sierra-40b-qlora-temp-q4f16` and limit rollout to eu-west1 Dedicated nodes. add fallback chain to `redwood-13b-q4f16`.
Jana (AE): pricing ask: they want a 3-month committed price below Dedicated list. we usually take an uplift for custom model support. what's a fair starting point?
Rohit (SE): baseline: hosted unit price * 2.0 + one-time validation fee. validation fee covers model conversion, regression suite, and a small support window.
Maya (ML Eng): estimate: validation harness + perf runs ~= 1.5 engineer-days, conversion and smoke tests ~= 1 engineer-day. total ~2.5 engineer-days.
Carlos (Infra Eng): infra cost estimate for POC (2 qps baseline, burst to 6 qps):
- Dedicated A100-80GB (eu-west1): 2 nodes reserved for 3 months
- ephemeral H100 burst for load test (1 day)
rough monthly infra: ~€18k (estimate).
Priya (Security): compliance blockers I see in the questionnaire: logging retention, data deletion SLA, and proof of EU data residency. I can draft answers but will need infra confirmation about control-plane metadata.
Sam (Customer): what about SLOs for the trial? they want 99.9 — do you accept for a POC?
Rohit (SE): we can offer a best-effort 99% for POC; 99.9% needs Dedicated with SLA contract and backbone reservations. recommend we offer 99% trial SLA and include upgrade path to 99.9 with Dedicated commit.
Jana (AE): ok action list:
- Rohit: spin up temp catalog entry + include fallback and routing restrictions (eu-only) 12h
- Maya: run conversion + 1k prompt regression harness and share perf numbers  today EOD
- Carlos: firm up infra pricing and availability in eu-west1  today EOD
- Priya: draft questionnaire responses and list missing customer docs  today EOD
- Jana: draft SOW with pricing tiers (trial vs committed) and send to Sam by EOD tomorrow
deploy-bot: created temp variant artifact id: dep-9001 for sierra-40b-qlora-temp-q4f16 (status: staging)
Rohit (SE): adding sample cache config snippet for the SOW:
```
model: sierra-40b-qlora-temp-q4f16
region: eu-west1
cache:
  enabled: true
  prefix: true
  ttl_seconds: 3600
fallbacks:
  - redwood-13b-q4f16
```
Maya (ML Eng): also recommend we run a small hallucination/QA eval as part of the 1k prompts to measure semantic drift vs 34B baseline.
Carlos (Infra Eng): noted and alerted capacity-team for potential reserved hardware. tagging @capacity.
Priya (Security): FYI customers with BYOK in the past provided a key policy and rotation window; please ask Sam to share.
Sam (Customer): will share key policy and sample workload by EOD. thanks all.
Jana (AE): thanks team 1:30 PT reconvene here tomorrow after the harness results.
